criteria.criterion: growth_get_actions is registered on the existing OpenSEO MCP server and mirrored from the same definition into SAM.
criteria.note: One shared definition is registered through both existing adapters; no server or transport was added.

criteria.criterion: Input is limited to project scope and bounded status, exact-category, minimum-priority, limit and cursor filters.
criteria.note: The strict schema defaults to 20, caps at 50, rejects unknown keys and invalid cursors, and canonicalizes status filters.

criteria.criterion: Canonical project authorization completes before Action storage is read.
criteria.note: The unauthorized-path test proves the read and mutation spies remain untouched when project membership fails.

criteria.criterion: The read covers all project Actions and remains separate from qualified priority-page Work.
criteria.note: listActionsPage reads growth_actions directly; listInvestigationWork retains its existing detector/run/signal qualification.

criteria.criterion: Pagination uses immutable createdAt/code-unit ID keyset order, project-leading predicates and limit plus one.
criteria.note: SQLite/D1 BINARY and live PostgreSQL C collation tests prove exact continuation; the service emits the last returned row only when more data exists.

criteria.criterion: Only emitted-page targets are bulk-loaded, the 100-target invariant is enforced and five display targets are exposed.
criteria.note: Tests prove the overflow row is excluded from target loading, JavaScript code-unit sorting precedes the five-target slice, and 101 stored targets fail closed.

criteria.criterion: The strict DTO exposes only approved Action summary and safe target fields.
criteria.note: Recommendation/run IDs, owner IDs, creation keys, hashes, actors, notes and raw rows are excluded and strict output validation rejects injected internal fields.

criteria.criterion: Mutable prose and URL targets use credential-safe projections with truthful redaction, truncation, omission and withholding state.
criteria.note: Repair round 1 reapplies public caps after sanitization; exact Unicode URL-expansion, credentials, email material, URL query/fragment omission and complete withholding are covered.

criteria.criterion: Descriptions are capped at 400 characters and overall output remains bounded to 50 Actions.
criteria.note: The service bounds after projection and the strict DTO independently enforces Action, prose and target caps.

criteria.criterion: The tool is read-only, closed-world, non-destructive, saved-data-only, zero-credit and provider-free.
criteria.note: The authorized handler makes one listActions call; annotations, description and no-mutation assertions match the implementation.

criteria.criterion: Human-readable output truthfully distinguishes empty, final and continuing pages.
criteria.note: Continuation text appears only with hasMore and directs callers to the structured nextCursor.

criteria.criterion: Standard metadata contains the authorized project ID and Growth Work deep link.
criteria.note: Both direct and real protocol tests retain /p/:projectId/growth#growth-work.

criteria.criterion: SAM hides model-visible projectId, injects the bound project and preserves filters and cursors.
criteria.note: The SAM test parses the model-facing schema, executes it and proves exact bound-project authorization/delegation.

criteria.criterion: ADR documentation records the sanitized current-list boundary and deferred detail/history/write scope.
criteria.note: ADR-037 records the keyset, privacy, shared-adapter and no-chain/no-mutation decisions.

criteria.criterion: No dependency, schema, migration, provider, billing, auth, scope, transport, route, server-function or UI change was added, and required checks/review pass.
evidence: git status and complete diff against 4744fb4
criteria.note: The final diff is confined to schemas, the existing repository/service/MCP/SAM layers, tests, ADR and run evidence; all gates and the post-repair fresh review pass.

limitations: Raw HTTP transport and an external headless MCP consumer probe were not run because the user's standing constraint prohibits HTTP and headless/browser activity. Those layers are not claimed as passed; a real no-network MCP client/server protocol exercise is included instead.

The disposable PostgreSQL fixture applied migration 0029's exact DDL in dependency-safe order because the checked-in SQL emits a referenced unique constraint after its foreign keys. No migration or product source was changed in this slice.
do_not_change: Keep the general all-Action read separate from qualified priority-page Work.
Keep createdAt plus provider-collated ID keyset ordering and limit-plus-one pagination.
Keep safe-text caps after sanitization and preserve truthful projection flags.
Keep canonical MCP project authorization and SAM's server-bound project injection.
Keep detail/history/evidence-chain reads and Action writes out of this tool.
